title: experimental-research (P1, R08) + control 28 — an empirical run carries a real experiment bound to a held hypothesis
objective: Build experimental-research as the 10th badf-research subskill (a concise SKILL.md, registered IMPLEMENTED; the family stays ACTIVE -- two-tier model), earning control 28 in validate_research_record: an R08 (EMPIRICAL_EXPERIMENT) record carries at least one experiment, and every experiment's hypothesis_ref resolves to a hypothesis the record holds. An empirical run that measured nothing, or tested a hypothesis it never stated, is not an experiment. Mirrors controls 23/24 (type-specific structure grounded in the record). Both gaps measured on 467406f: an R08/D5 record with experiments=[] is admitted, and an experiment citing hypothesis_ref H-999 the record does not hold is admitted.
business_value: R08 was the one research type without a dedicated subskill or integrity control -- it routed to the raw experiment mechanism and the gate never checked an empirical run actually ran an experiment. Control 28 closes that: a controlled measurement that produced no experiment, or cited a hypothesis the record never stated, is a deterministic refusal. Completes the research family's type coverage (R01-R10) without weakening any invariant -- control 28 only refuses more, never approves more, and grants no implementation authority (RSR-I01).
in_scope: control 28 in badf_gate.py validate_research_record: R08 requires >=1 experiment; every experiment hypothesis_ref resolves to a held hypothesis (referential integrity, all records)
